about_lead: “Volunteers” is a youth volunteering association born from the dream of a group of young people from Catania: to be the overwhelming proof that, in the 21st century, being human is not just a possibility, but an ancestral duty that has never faded.
about_body: Volunteers is, without euphemism, an act of rebellion: we rebel against apathy, unbridled individualism and the passivity of modern society. Rooted in altruism and empathy, Volunteers is a light of hope both for those who help and for those who are helped.
about_image_alt: Volunteers wearing Volunteers t-shirts playing with young girls
about_story_title: Our story is made of people
about_story_description: We know we are not alone: we know we are not the only ones who feel the need to be human. That is why our very first goal is to make the opportunity to do good accessible to everyone.
about_documents_description: Transparency, accountability and care guide every choice we make. Here you can find the Foundation's official documents.
project_find_group_description: Look up your nearest local branch and contact the team to find out about upcoming activities.
find_group_description: We are the most widespread youth solidarity movement on the ground. Our local groups are active in more than 20 Italian and European cities. We are united by a passion for changing things from the bottom up, having fun and leaving a real impact on local communities. Search the map for the group nearest you, or start a new one!
